parties: Wipro Limited (acquirer, via subsidiaries) | Alpha Net Consulting LLC and subsidiaries (target)
headline: Wipro acquires select customer contracts of Alpha Net Consulting LLC; completion extended to 30 September 2026
sum: Wipro has delayed completion of its acquisition of select customer contracts from Alpha Net Consulting LLC and subsidiaries from 30 June to 30 September 2026. The definitive agreement was signed on 14 April 2026; no acquisition price has been disclosed.
implication: Regulatory filing discipline: timely intimation to exchange of material transaction timelines under Listing Rules Reg 30 signals governance rigour; the extension suggests post-signing integration or regulatory approval complexities typical in cross-border IP/services M&A.
detail: Wipro Limited, acting through subsidiaries, entered into a definitive agreement on 14 April 2026 to acquire select customer contracts and associated assets from Alpha Net Consulting LLC and its subsidiaries. The transaction was initially expected to close by 30 June 2026 but has now been extended to 30 September 2026, as intimated to the NSE under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR), 2015. The acquisition is of customer contracts and related business rather than an entire entity acquisition, suggesting a targeted, asset-light carve-out structure. No consideration has been disclosed in public filings.
